name: Eager Beavers

features.name: Wild Rapids
features.description: Wild features in the base game.

review:
Busy beavers on six reels with random heights and up to 1,000,000 ways. Wild features fill the base game, and in the Cash Bonus Game you build, upgrade and collect.

The building-and-collecting bonus gives it a different feel from most ways games. High volatility, 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.29%, below average, so try it in demo first.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
